description: Transporte Público Flexível is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Município de Castelo Branco. How does it work? The customer must contact the telephone number 800 272 000 by 3 p.m. on the eve of the day on which he intends to travel. After collecting all the requests, the Municipality Operations Center organizes the itinerary according to the reservations. Until 5.30 p.m. Coverage: Município de Castelo Branco. The portal shows the English title as "Flexible public transport" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Município de Castelo Branco. Its keywords include sociedade-da-informacao, flexivel. The listing shows 1 download or service links in URL. The listing shows 2025-10-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
